title: Bachata Styling with Anastasia Supernova
description:
Step into your power and embrace your feminine energy in this dynamic styling class led by Anastasia Supernova, one of the top Bachata instructors in the U.S.

Through sensual movement, musical connection, and expressive technique, Anastasia helps dancers unlock confidence, grace, and personal flair. Her Supernova Method blends ballroom precision with Latin soul—guiding you to move from the heart and shine on any dance floor.

Open to all levels, this class is a celebration of self-expression, body awareness, and unapologetic style

Cost $15

*Not included in the Unlimited Monthly Pass

title: Sensual Heidelberg Saturdays
description:
🍀 Sensual Heidelberg Saturdays – St. Patrick’s Day Edition 🍀
📅 Saturday, March 14
🕘 9:15 PM – 2:00 AM
📍 Heidelberg

It’s time to mix sensual vibes with a little Irish luck 🍀🔥
Join us for a special St. Patrick’s Day edition filled with smooth bachata, spicy salsa, great energy, and festive green touches all night long!

💃 9:15 – 10:00 PM | Bachata Class with Emrah & Samara
Kick off the evening with a flowing sensual bachata workshop focused on connection, musicality, and clean partnerwork. Open level – everyone welcome!

🎶 Music Format (All Night): 3 Bachata + 1 Salsa
We keep the perfect balance: every 3 bachata songs followed by 1 salsa song – so both bachata and salsa dancers get their moments.

🎉 10:55 PM | Birthday Circle
We celebrate Justin, Katie, Jessie & Ayman!
Come join the circle and share the love.

🔥 11:00 PM – 12:00 AM | Sensual Bachata Power Hour
One full hour of uninterrupted sensual bachata.
No salsa breaks. Just pure flow, connection, and energy.

🕑 Dancing continues until 2:00 AM.

Wear something green, bring your best energy, and let’s turn Heidelberg into the hottest St. Patrick’s dance floor 🍀💃🕺

title: Ritmo Noir Society - A Rooftop Social: Salsa Bachata Kizomba & More!
description:
Step into Ritmo Noir Society, Detroit’s newest upscale Afro‑Latin rooftop social at t I|O Godfrey (Hotel) Rooftop Lounge— where elegance, rhythm, and community meet above the city lights.

We bring together dancers from every corner of the Afro‑Latin scene for a night of elevated ambiance and refined energy.
Begin the evening with a beginner‑friendly Salsa class designed to welcome all levels into the flow.

Then dance under the stars, as DJ Alejandro curates a smooth blend of salsa, bachata, kizomba, and more! A true celebration of Afro‑Latin genres in one sophisticated space.

Rooftop views. Curated vibes. A soundtrack that moves Detroit.

This is Ritmo Noir Society.

I|O Godfrey Rooftop Lounge is a chic, modern bar on top of The Godfrey Hotel in Detroit, known for panoramic city views, craft cocktails, and small plates, featuring retractable glass walls and ceiling for an indoor-outdoor experience. It offers a sophisticated atmosphere with curated drinks and food, making it a popular spot for nightlife and social gatherings, though it has a smart casual dress code and is geared towards an adult crowd.

Cost:
$15 Pre Sale / $20 At The Door
*Eventbrite Fees Additional
Purchase your ticket on Eventbrite!

Get ready for a night of elegance, connection, and incredible music! Join us for our favorite Saturday social. Whether you're a seasoned dancer or just starting, we’ve crafted the perfect night to elevate your Bachata and Salsa experience.

🕒 THE SCHEDULE
• 9:00 PM: Doors Open – Arrive early to mingle and catch the vibe!
• 9:15 PM: Bachata Class with Emrah & Samara. We’re breaking down the technique and flow to get you feeling confident on the floor.
• 11:00 PM – 12:00 AM: Uninterrupted Sensual Bachata Power Hour. One full hour of pure, smooth Bachata to keep the energy high.

Social dancing with our signature rotation: 3 Bachatas followed by 1 Salsa all night long.

🎶 THE VIBE
DJ Kev is bringing you the best hits to keep you moving until 2:00 AM.
• Cover: $10

Come experience the unique "75% Bachata / 25% Salsa" ratio that keeps the floor hot and the energy Sensual. See you on the dance floor! 💃🕺

title: PURE DANCE Social
description:
🔥PURE DANCE SOCIAL🔥

📍Phoenix Center - 220 S Main St, Ann Arbor

🎊🎊TWO ROOMS!🎊🎊
Bachata room: Mainly bachata and some Merengue and Kizomba.
Salsa room: Salsa, Timba and some Cumbia.

SCHEDULE
* Registration: 8:15pm - 8:30pm
* Class:            8:30pm - 9:30pm
‼️Early Socia:  9:30pm - 1:00 am‼️

- New music and more styles included so you can enjoy a great variety of music. 🎶🎵
- 12 Spots available in our special guest list for veterans. All the dancers who have been supporting our dance scene in Michigan since before COVID! DM to reserve your spot. 🎫♥️ (Reservation not valid on the same day of the event)
- and as big incentive. Ask about our discount cards and discounts for our passionate dancers when you visit us from Canada, Toledo, and Grand Rapids! 🎟️♥️
Please follow the new (IG page) and (FB page) for more info.

title: Hoover St September Social
description:
Hello everyone! Our September monthly social + class is here! At the social, we will be playing a mix of salsa, timba, bachata, merengue, Cha Cha, etc!

Class: 8:30pm - 9:30pm 
It will be an all level salsa on 2 class taught by Irene! Come and join us!

Social Time: 9:30pm - 1:00am
💃🏽 Mix of salsa, timba and bachata for all hours! 🕺

Location: Hoover St Studio (323 E Hoover Ave)

Social or class individually: $10
Social + class: $15

We hope to dance with you then!
